translations.web: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
translations.bsb: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
translations.kjv: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
translations.asv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that of all that which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
